title: Installment Extensions on the Kestrel Advantage Balloon Retail Installment Sale Contract
content:
An extension defers installments of a Kestrel Advantage Balloon Retail Installment Sale Contract to the end of the term.

## Conditions for granting

1. **Status.** An extension can be granted only while the contract status is active.
2. **Counts.** The contract must show installments satisfied of at least the tier's minimum, days past due of no more than the tier's maximum, and extensions used over its life plus the installments requested no greater than the tier's lifetime maximum.
3. **Blackout.** No extension is granted when the remaining installments are the tier's blackout number or fewer. The remaining installments are the term in months plus the installments already deferred by extensions less the installments satisfied.
4. **Relationship.** No extension is granted while any other Kestrel contract of the customer is assigned for repossession, repossessed, in deficiency or charged off, or any Kestrel lease of the customer is repossessed or charged off.
5. **Interval.** An extension may take effect no earlier than the tier's interval in calendar months after the previous extension took effect. The interval is counted in calendar months from the last extension date to the same day number of the later month, falling back to that month's last day when the day does not exist; a contract never extended has no interval to wait. An extension taking effect on the day the interval ends is permitted.
6. **Size.** One request may defer no more than the tier's maximum per request, always starting with the installment due on the next due date.
7. **Good faith.** Before the extension is granted, a good-faith payment of at least the tier's good-faith percentage of the monthly payment, rounded to the cent, must have posted since the most recent installment due date; a tier whose percentage is 0 requires none.
8. **Signed agreement.** The agent sends the extension agreement for signature, and it expires if not completed within the tier's agreement return days in calendar days. The extension takes effect only after the customer has completed the signed extension agreement for this contract.

Conditions 1 to 3 and 5 are read from the contract record; condition 4 from the customer's other Kestrel contracts and leases; condition 8 from the customer's signature request for this contract.

## Fee and effect

The extension fee is the tier's extension fee where the contract records that its state permits an extension fee, and 0.00 where it does not; the fee is booked to fees due. On the effective date the next due date and the maturity date each move later by one month per deferred installment, the extensions used over the life of the contract increase by the number deferred and the last extension date is set; simple interest keeps accruing on principal throughout, so the final installment absorbs the extra interest. Late charges already assessed remain due, and no late charge is assessed on a deferred installment.

## Hypothetical case

A 48-month contract with 1 installment already deferred and 42 installments satisfied has 7 remaining installments; with a blackout of 6 it is outside the blackout. After 1 more satisfied installment it has 6 remaining and no extension is granted.
